auth.registerSubtitle: Check medication availability and chat with the pharmacy.

inventory.title: Inventory

findingExpired.other: {count} medications are holding expired stock that cannot be dispensed.

findingLow.one: {count} medication is at or below its reorder level.
findingLow.other: {count} medications are at or below their reorder level.

findingExpiring.one: {count} lot expires within {days} days. Nothing is below its reorder level.
findingExpiring.other: {count} lots expire within {days} days. Nothing is below its reorder level.

inventory.findingClear: Every medication is above its reorder level with no lot expiring within {days} days.
inventory.stockNote: Quantities exclude expired lots, which cannot be dispensed.

table.caption: Medications with stock on hand, reorder level, next expiry date and status.

batch.title: Stock lots
batch.empty: No stock lots. Add one below to put this medication back in stock.
batch.caption: Stock lots for {name}, each with its own expiry date.

medicationForm.name: Medication name
medicationForm.openingNote: Stock is tracked per lot so each delivery keeps its own expiry date. More lots can be added afterwards.

stock.title: Add stock
stock.subtitle: Receive a new lot, or add a medication the catalog does not carry yet
stock.question: What are you stocking?
stock.newOption: + New medication (not in the catalog yet)
stock.added: Added {name} to the catalog with its first stock lot.

sell.title: Dispense
sell.finding: Stock leaves the shelf when a sale is completed. Each line is drawn from the lot closest to expiry first, and the move cannot be undone.
sell.addFormLabel: Add a medication to the sale
sell.errorQuantityMin: Enter a quantity of at least 1

errorOnlyAvailableWithExisting.one: Only {count} unit of {name} available and {existing} already in this sale
errorOnlyAvailableWithExisting.other: Only {count} units of {name} available and {existing} already in this sale

sell.errorEmpty: Add at least one medication to the sale.
sell.empty: Nothing added yet. Add one or more medications above to build the sale.
sell.currentCaption: Medications in the sale being built, with the lots each will be drawn from.
sell.recentCaption: The most recent sales recorded at this pharmacy.
sell.confirmLead: Stock leaves the shelf now. This cannot be undone.
sell.dispensed: Dispensed {units} across {medications}, total {total}. Stock has been reduced.

forecast.title: Demand forecast
forecast.subtitle: Pick a medication to train its model on the latest sales and chart the result
forecast.insufficientDefault: Not enough sales history to train a model yet.
forecast.insufficientNote: The model needs at least 14 days of history before it will forecast, so no reorder alert is raised for this medication (UC-3 alternative flow).

dailyNote.one: Units sold per day over the last 30 days, then the model's predicted demand for the next {count} day.
dailyNote.other: Units sold per day over the last 30 days, then the model's predicted demand for the next {count} days.

forecast.projectedNote: Current stock less the predicted demand each day, against this medication's reorder threshold.

chart.noSales: No sales recorded for this medication yet.
chart.demandAria: Daily units sold over the last {history} days, followed by {forecast} days of predicted demand
chart.projectionAria: Projected stock falling from {quantity} units against a reorder threshold of {threshold}

alerts.title: Reorder alerts
alerts.note: Forecast from this pharmacy's own sales. Predicted to fall below its reorder level within {days} days.
alerts.none: No reorder alerts. Nothing is forecast to fall below its reorder level in the next {days} days.
alerts.fallsOn: Falls below its reorder level on {date}

chat.selectedImage: The image you are about to send
chat.captionHint: Add a caption below if you like, then send.
chat.onlyImages: Only image files can be sent: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF.
chat.imageTooLarge: Images can be at most {count} MB.
chat.imageLoadFailed: This image could not be loaded.
chat.reconnecting: Reconnecting... new messages may be delayed.
chat.selectPatient: Select a patient to view the conversation.

preorders.mineNote: The pharmacy updates these as your medication comes in.
preorders.requestLead: The pharmacy sees your request and you can follow it here. Nothing is reserved or paid for until you collect it.
preorders.requestSent: Your request for {name} has been sent.
preorders.requestCancelled: Your request for {name} has been cancelled.
preorders.cancelLead: Your request for {name} will be withdrawn.

findingReady.one: {count} request is ready and waiting to be collected.
findingReady.other: {count} requests are ready and waiting to be collected.

preorders.caption: Preorder requests from patients, newest first, with their status.

moved.ready: {name} for {patient} is marked ready to collect.
moved.collected: {name} handed over to {patient}. The stock has been dispensed.
moved.cancelled: The request for {name} from {patient} is cancelled.

preorders.collectLead: {quantity} × {name} for {patient}. The stock is dispensed now, nearest expiry first, and this cannot be undone.
preorders.staffCancelLead: {patient} will see the request as cancelled.

reset.forgotSubtitle: Enter the email of your account and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
reset.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. It works once and expires in {minutes} minutes.
reset.resetSubtitle: Enter a new password for your account.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.done: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.

presence.pharmacyOffline: Pharmacy offline. Your message will be answered when someone is back.
presence.unknown: Checking whether the pharmacy is online...

account.title: Your account
account.erasesChat: your whole chat history with the pharmacy, including the pharmacy's replies
account.erasesPreorders: your preorder requests, open or finished
account.erasesImages: every image you or the pharmacy sent in your chat
account.erasesAccount: your account itself: you will not be able to sign in with it again
account.cannotUndo: This cannot be undone. Medications already collected stay in the pharmacy's sales records, without your name.
account.passwordRequired: Enter your password to delete your account.
account.confirmLead: Everything listed on this page is erased now, and you are signed out.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: There is no page at this address. It may have moved, or the link may be mistyped.

about.title: About {name}
about.intro: {name} runs this portal so you can check on your medication without a trip to the counter.
about.availabilityBody: See whether a medication is in stock right now before you come in.
about.chatBody: Ask about a medication, a dose or an order, and get a written answer in your chat.
about.preorderTitle: Request a medication that is out of stock
about.preorderBody: Ask the pharmacy to get it in; your request shows here as pending, then ready to collect.
about.contactLink: All the ways to contact the pharmacy

contact.title: Contact {name}
contact.patientLead: The quickest way to reach a pharmacist is the chat you already have.
contact.signedOutLead: Call, email or visit us. Patients with an account can also message a pharmacist after signing in.
